_schema._general: Fighting Style is a pick-one-of-N choice bundled into the class table as a single named feature ('Fighting Style' / 'fighter-fighting-style' etc.) rather than one features_by_level entry per option — structurally the same problem Pact Boon solves (see pact-boons.json), just with a class-specific option list instead of one shared across a class. Granted at Fighter 1st, Paladin 2nd, Ranger 2nd (per each class's features_by_level). Real RAW: never re-chosen after being picked (no swap), matching Pact Boon's precedent.
_schema.id: Same id used in engine/data/feature-catalog.json and the SRD cache's own `index` (src/data/api_data_cache/features.json) — see invocations.json's schema note for why. Paladin's variant ids intentionally have no 'paladin-' prefix ('fighting-style-defense', not 'paladin-fighting-style-defense') because that's how they're already keyed in the SRD cache — matched rather than renamed to avoid a duplicate/orphaned id.
_schema.found: 2026-09-09 — discovered via a real bug report: the New Character Tool lists 'Fighting Style' under Spells & Features for Fighter/Paladin/Ranger but has no way to actually choose one, because the engine never emitted a pendingChoice for it. Fixed alongside this file.
